purpose: Audited history then bounded tactical comparison; no frozen V1 rewrite or official Shadow backfill
sources: Whole daily Yahoo OHLC/adjusted close plus TWSE monthly raw OHLC and official action notices. Retain raw receipts and fail on unresolved conflict.
units: Fractional adjusted notional research units, same convention for all primary models. Not executable broker share counts.
execution: Signal at close; earliest following actual instrument session OPEN, never event trough/high. Stops/targets/trailing evaluated on close then next-open exit. No same-close execution.
feature_training: Only earlier bars; annual positive crash velocity percentile from years strictly before test year. No future labels or full-sample fitted percentiles.
position_rules: One episode/position; at most two 50% tranches in addition variants. Repeated signals cannot reset episode/holding clock. Exit before add. Bound new notional to10% marked NAV; gap/intraday exposure breaches reported, not guaranteed away.
folds: Expanding annual chronological test2018 onward. Nested prior-year walk-forward completed trades choose model, minimum5 training trades; last70 prior-year sessions excluded from new training signals to purge60-day horizons and confirmation/entry delay. Otherwise retain cash. Carry an existing trade's original exit policy across year changes.
selection_objective: Prior-data net annualized growth / max(absolute drawdown,0.02), tie by fewer adds, shorter max hold, lexicographic model ID. Report every candidate, not just winner.
validation_label: Historical post-selection walk-forward reanalysis. L2-L7 and known2024-2026 cases already inspected; NEVER claim fresh independent OOS. Prospective untouched validation begins only after this protocol registration.
benchmarks: 00631L and0050 buy/hold100% context plus same10%-cap versions and all-cash. Adjusted0050 gross total-return proxy must be verified; exclude investor-specific dividend taxes and payment-date cash drag explicitly.
score_policy: Do not manufacture weights or0-100 buy score. Diagnose factor monotonicity/uncertainty using training-only bins, cluster episodes, minimum30 mature independent events for exploratory aggregate inference. Formal score withheld without new prospective calibration, bear-regime coverage and parameter stability; these are research screens, not modifications of frozen gates.
